subject: DataHarvest commercial reconciliation & contract amendment request
messages:
From: Karen Li <karen.li@dataharvest.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>; Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procure@dataharvest.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Service impact and request for commercial adjustment

Hi Ben / Marissa,

I wanted to raise a formal concern following the sustained latency and error-rate spikes we've observed across our inference pipelines between Nov 3 - Nov 10. Our engineering team captured increased p99 latency (+420ms vs baseline) and a sustained 3.7% request error rate on peak windows. We rely on consistent SLA performance for our customer-facing product and this window directly impacted a scheduled batch release.

Attached is a trimmed log extract (datadump_latency_log_20261112.csv) with sample traces and timestamps. Our finance team is estimating direct revenue impact of ~$48k for the affected period; procurement is asking for a commercial reconciliation and a proposed amendment to the contract to include clearer remediation credits and faster escalation paths.

Request: please propose a credit calculation approach and an amended SLA clause or a short-term commitment (dedicated capacity / priority routing) to prevent recurrence. We are copying procurement to begin paper trail.

Appreciate a prompt response — ideally before EOD tomorrow Nov 13 so we can present internally.

Thanks,
Karen Li
VP of Engineering
DataHarvest Inc.

---
Attachment: datadump_latency_log_20261112.csv (CSV, 45KB)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Karen Li <karen.li@dataharvest.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Service impact and request for commercial adjustment

Hi Karen — thanks for the detailed note and for sending the logs. Sorry for the disruption; I understand the urgency.

Quick plan:
- We will run a full post-mortem and share a timeline by Friday Nov 14.
- Marissa will surface the impacted request counts by route/model and provide a provisional credit calc.
- I'll route this to our legal and ops execs for approval; Vivek will help with any exec-level commercial asks.

As an interim offer, we're prepared to propose a provisional credit equal to 12% of your billed usage for Nov (to be reconciled after full audit), plus priority capacity for a 2-week window while we tune routing. If that works, we can move to a contract amendment that codifies the credit and the priority routing terms.

Can you confirm acceptance of the interim approach and whether procurement needs a formal PDF quote to begin internal approvals? If you prefer a call, I propose 1pm PT today.

Best,
Ben Carter
Senior Sales Manager
Redwood Inference

Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 12:40:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Service impact and request for commercial adjustment

Karen — appreciate the logs. I pulled usage and error-rate breakdowns for your account and attached a draft credit calculation workbook (credit_calc_proposal.xlsx). Highlights:

- Impact window: 2026-11-03 00:00 - 2026-11-10 23:59 PST
- Affected routes: /v1/generate (primary), /v1/embed (minor)
- Measured extra error volume: ~13,200 failed tokens/tests over window
- Proposed credit: 12% provisional of Nov invoice (aligned with Ben's note), final figure to be reconciled after our audit.

Mutual action plan (MAP):
1) We’ll assign a dedicated tuning team for 2 weeks (Nov 15 - Nov 29) to apply routing/quantization tweaks.
2) Increase your autoscaling floor on /v1/generate for peak windows for 14 days.
3) Shared telemetry and weekly checkpoints (Wed mornings).

I attached the workbook with line items. If procurement needs an official SOW or a ticket (we'll create JIRA-OPS-5892) we can attach to the amendment.

Marissa
Account Lead, Redwood Inference

---
Attachment: credit_calc_proposal.xlsx (Excel, 72KB)

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Procurement <procure@dataharvest.com>; Karen Li <karen.li@dataharvest.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Service impact and request for commercial adjustment

Karen / Procurement team — looping in from legal to accelerate contract language.

We can provide a one-off amendment that:
- Documents the provisional credit and the later reconciliation approach (audit window + evidence exchange).
- Adds a 14-day priority routing and a commitment to evaluate Dedicated capacity options within 30 days.
- Clarifies escalation SLAs and points-of-contact for executive escalation.

We'll aim to deliver a redline by EOD Monday Nov 16. For procurement: please confirm the contracting contact and the preferred signing authority (DocuSign recipient). We prefer to keep the amendment limited in scope (credit + routing + escalation path) so it doesn't trigger a full legal review cycle.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

---
Attachment: proposed_amendment_draft.docx (Word, 28KB)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Karen Li <karen.li@dataharvest.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 10:50:00 -08:00
Subject: Executive note: preliminary credit approval & remediation commitment

Karen — I’m stepping in to make sure this gets resolved quickly. On behalf of Redwood:

1) Credit: we approve a preliminary, one-time credit equal to 12% of your November invoice, to be issued as a billing credit within three business days of the amendment being signed. The credit will be final after a joint audit (we’ll share the audit scope).
2) Capacity: we will provision priority routing and increase autoscaling floors for /v1/generate for 14 days starting Nov 15; if that does not remediate the issue we will evaluate a Dedicated capacity trial (pricing and timeline to be specified).
3) Process: Laura will finalize a narrow amendment. Ben / Marissa will share the credit workbook and JIRA-OPS-5892 for tracking.

I understand the operational impact this caused — I want to ensure we restore confidence quickly and provide clear steps to avoid recurrence. I’ll personally review the post-mortem and the final reconciliation.

Vivek Kulkarni
Chief Revenue Officer
Redwood Inference

Ben / Vivek / Laura / Marissa — thank you for the quick engagement and the proposed path. Procurement reviewed the draft amendment and the credit workbook. We will accept the provisional 12% credit and the 14-day priority routing window, pending a signed amendment. Procurement confirms the signer is our CFO (Michael Torres) — please send the DocuSign to michael.torres@dataharvest.com.

A couple of asks to close this:
- Can Redwood commit to the billing credit appearing on our Dec invoice (we need it reflected for month-end close)?
- We’d like the Joint Audit scope within 5 business days after signing.
- Please confirm the timeline for Dedicated capacity evaluation if priority routing doesn't fully address tail latency.

If you can get the finalized amendment into DocuSign today or tomorrow we can route quickly on our side. Appreciated.

Best,
Karen Li
VP of Engineering
DataHarvest Inc.
